create.name: Lisa Marchiano
create.bio:
Lisa Marchiano is a Jungian analyst and writer who helps people read the language of dreams, myth and fairy tale. After studying medieval European history at Brown University, international affairs at Columbia and social work at New York University, she trained with the Interregional Society of Jungian Analysts, qualifying in 2011, and now teaches and supervises candidates at the C. G. Jung Institute of Philadelphia. In 2018 she started the podcast This Jungian Life with fellow analysts Deborah Stewart and Joseph Lee, a series that has brought Jung's ideas to a wide international audience through conversation and the reading of listeners' dreams.

Her books draw on old stories to look at modern lives. Motherhood: Facing and Finding Yourself treats parenting as a path of inner growth, The Vital Spark explores the 'outlaw' qualities women are often taught to hide, and Dream Wise, written with her podcast co-hosts, sets out a step-by-step method for working with dreams. With them she also runs Dream School, a year-long online course. She hosts women's retreats built around fairy tales, story, movement and dreamwork, writes the free Café Jung newsletter, and at Kripalu leads weekends on dream incubation and interpretation.

books.title: Dream Wise: Unlocking the Meaning of Your Dreams
books.author: Lisa Marchiano, Deborah Stewart and Joseph Lee
books.description: Written with her This Jungian Life co-hosts, this guide turns Jung's approach to dreams into a self-directed method. It offers 69 keys for exploring dream images, covering archetypes, emotions, shadow figures and the shape of a dream.

books.title: The Vital Spark: Reclaim Your Outlaw Energies and Find Your Feminine Fire
books.author: Lisa Marchiano
books.description: Using fairy tales from many cultures alongside personal stories, the book looks at eight traits women are often taught to suppress, among them shrewdness, desire, anger, authority and ruthlessness, and how reclaiming them restores a fuller sense of self.

books.title: Motherhood: Facing and Finding Yourself
books.author: Lisa Marchiano
books.description: Her first book reads the demands of raising children through fairy tale and myth. It focuses on the mother's own psychological development and treats parenthood as a stage on the way to wholeness.

courses.title: The Wisdom of Your Dreams: Unlock the Language of the Unconscious
courses.description: A weekend workshop at Kripalu introducing Jung's view of dreams, with prompts and keys for finding meaning in them. It includes small-group and paired practice, a Saturday dream incubation ritual and a Sunday session on the dreams that follow.

courses.title: Finding Your Myth
courses.description: A five-day women's retreat in the mountains of Puerto Rico, co-led with Jungian analyst Deborah Stewart. The group asks Jung's question about the personal myth one is living, working through story, art, movement and dreams; meals and lodging are included.

courses.title: This Jungian Life Dream School
courses.description: A self-paced, year-long online course in Jungian dream work from the three This Jungian Life hosts. A new module opens each month, with monthly live Zoom sessions and a community of fellow students.

free_resources.title: Café Jung
free_resources.description: Her free Substack newsletter on Jungian psychology in everyday life. It sends short weekly reflections built on a quote, plus monthly conversations with authors, artists and analysts.

free_resources.title: This Jungian Life Podcast
free_resources.description: The free weekly podcast she co-hosts with Deborah Stewart and Joseph Lee. Episodes discuss a theme from depth psychology and close by interpreting a dream sent in by a listener.
